title: GAYLETTER Issue 18

description.main: The eighteenth print issue of GAYLETTER, with a cover and cover story on the photographer Stanley Stellar and his pictures of New York's West Side piers.
description.extended:
The eighteenth print issue of GAYLETTER, published in 2023, with a cover and cover story on the photographer Stanley Stellar and his pictures of New York's West Side piers.

The cover is a Stellar colour photograph of a man with his jeans lowered, leaning in the doorway of a derelict pier building beside a graffiti drawing of dancing figures. Inside, the feature is written by Hussein Omar and runs with Stellar's photographs, courtesy of the artist and Kapp Kapp gallery, and portraits by Mary Manning. Introducing the story, the editors wrote that Stellar spent many days in the 1970s at the piers photographing the gay and trans people who cruised them, and that he insisted on "depicting gay life as joyous, horny, and free." GAYLETTER began in 2008 as a weekly email newsletter and launched its print magazine in 2014.

Stellar (b. 1945, Brooklyn) has photographed gay life in New York since the 1970s. The pier pictures are collected in The Piers (Kapp Kapp, 2023), and a wider survey of his archive followed in Don't Worry Boys (Loose Joints, 2026).

notes: Signed copy. Identified from the GAYLETTER Substack post of 1 September 2023 introducing the Issue 18 cover story (https://gayletter.substack.com/p/stanley-stellar). Feature credits from that post: text by Hussein Omar, photography by Stanley Stellar, portraits by Mary Manning. Page count and dimensions are not given by the publisher. Cover is the shop product image cropped to the front cover.
